title: Where is the specs of my crs app, i have so many modules for

messages.content: Where is the specs of my crs app, i have so many modules for which modules we have completed the specs give me table please

This confirms the 10 modules with completed specs (module 38 = Onboarding + Job Board is the 11th, added in v20). All others are pending. Here's the answer:

## Spec status — `specs/CRS_Blueprint.html`

Full detailed specs (18-dimension breakdown) exist for **11 of 46 modules**. Everything else is a roadmap placeholder row only — no spec written yet.

| # | Module | Section | Spec status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | Reporting | Operations | ✅ Complete |
| 02 | Task Management | Operations | ✅ Complete |
| 03 | Request for Investigation (RFI) | Operations | ✅ Complete |
| 15 | Employee Management | HR / Employees | ✅ Complete |
| 29 | Roles & Permissions | Admin / Core | ✅ Complete |
| 30 | Notifications | Admin / Core | ✅ Complete |
| 31 | User Management | Admin / Core | ✅ Complete |
| 32 | Casino Settings | Admin / Core | ✅ Complete |
| 33 | System Activity Log | Admin / Core | ✅ Complete |
| 38 | Onboarding + Job Board | HR / Employees | ✅ Complete (added v20) |

**Remaining 35 modules** — no spec section written, roadmap-only ("Pending" tag in the table at `specs/CRS_Blueprint.html:1507`+).

⚠️ Don't conflate this with **build status** (`brain/STATUS.md`): spec-complete ≠ built. Of these 11 spec'd modules, only **Roles & Permissions** and **Casino Settings** are actually built + NEG-proven in Bubble; User Management is UI-built with security pending; the rest (Reporting, Task Management, RFI, Employee Management, Notifications, System Activity Log, Onboarding+Job Board) have a written spec but are 🔴 not started in the actual app.
